data.name: Hyameen
data.gender_notes: Hyameen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hyameen is derived from the Arabic word 'hyam' meaning 'moon'. This name signifies the light and beauty that the moon brings to the night sky. In Islamic tradition, the moon is often seen as a symbol of blessings, guidance, and peace. The name Hyameen carries the meaning “Moon light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hyameen usually hope their child will grow to embody moon light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Hyameen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hyameen total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
